notes.title: BRUTALISTIKA Demo Update 25/02/2025
notes.content:
[h1]Add some clues and add some control settings[/h1]

Hello everyone !

Here is a small update of the demo ːsteamthumbsupː

[h1][h2]What's new?[/h2][/h1]

[h2]Clues[/h2]
Hidden items are placed in certain places to give you clues on how to use certain elements!
Let's find them !
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45339606/ab82df1d0e42cb058996a9b74e831599223652c0.png[/img]

[h2]Settings[/h2]
Control settings toggle to invert the Y camera.
Control settings slider to adjust the sensitivity of the camera.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45339606/d170cd3c51bb90762b0d4416d38f426d0d43baef.png[/img]


This is just the beginning, others will come gradually to improve your pleasure :-)
We hope you will love those new feature.

Share your review !

Way16a Studio Team

notes.title: Demo release
notes.content:
[h1]BRUTALISTIKA demo is now available on Steam![/h1]

BRUTALISTIKA is an immersive and contemplative experience.

In this walking simulator, explore mysterious and intriguing liminal spaces with neo-brutalist architecture, filled with peaceful pools and interactive works that invite you to interpret your emotions at your own pace.

We can't wait to hear your feedback on this intriguing universe where not everything is revealed...
You'll have to wait for the final version to solve and try to understand all its mysteries :-)

👉 Test the demo and add it to your wishlist so you don't miss any upcoming announcements!
https://store.steampowered.com/app/3527970/BRUTALISTIKA_Demo

Thank you for your support and feedback which will allow us to improve the final version.
🖤💛❤️

notes.title: BRUTALISTIKA Steam page available !
notes.content:
[h1]🎉 BRUTALISTIKA is coming to Steam! 🚀[/h1]

We are extremely happy to share a major milestone in our adventure: the Steam page for [b]BRUTALISTIKA[/b], our second game, is now public! 🌟

This is a special moment for the whole team, and we can't wait to reveal more of this unique universe.

[b]BRUTALISTIKA [/b]is an immersive and contemplative experience.
In this walking simulator, explore at your own pace mysterious and intriguing liminal spaces with neo-brutalist architecture, filled with peaceful pools and interactive works that invite you to interpret your emotions.

Your support, feedback and your whishlists will be essential in this key phase of development ! 

Thanks to everyone who makes this adventure possible. 

We still have lots of surprises in store for you! 🖤
